verdict.rationale: Canva's docs describe design export in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) through its MCP server and automated resizing to new dimensions and formats. That covers whole-design, multi-format export, but nothing in the evidence shows the per-layer production-asset workflow the story asks for. Missing for 10: SVG export evidence, per-layer/element export presets, export scale multipliers, slices, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
